rules.value: 5 hashtags maximum per post or Reel (down from 30). Instagram announced Dec 2025 it would gradually reduce caption hashtags to 5; rollout is staged so accounts may not all see it at once, and Meta Business Suite scheduler backend may still accept up to 30. Exceeding 5 in-app can strip extra tags and suppress Explore/hashtag/Reels distribution. Instagram recommends 3-5 targeted tags. Historical cap was 30 (pre-2025).

rules.value: Instagram maintains a rotating, UNPUBLISHED list of restricted/banned hashtags that changes constantly. Examples confirmed restricted at various times in 2026 by public guides: #alone, #brain, #pushups, #followforfollow, #adulting, #beautyblogger, #dm, #desk, #kissing, #tag4like. There is no official public list. Only reliable check: search the tag inside the Instagram app — a 'recent posts hidden' warning means restricted. Tools must use curated samples + disclaimer, never claim live verification.
